PCOD (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome) is one of the most common hormonal conditions affecting women of reproductive age. It can impact menstrual health, fertility, and overall hormonal balance.

• Irregular or missed periods
• Difficulty in ovulation
• Acne & oily skin
• Excess facial or body hair (hirsutism)
• Weight gain & insulin resistance
• Polycystic ovaries on ultrasound
• Fertility challenges

Intrauterine Insemination (IUI) is a safe, simple, and effective fertility treatment designed to help couples improve their chances of conception. At Dr. Patil's IVF & Fertility Clinic – Goregaon, IUI is performed with precision and personalized care to support your journey toward parenthood.

During the IUI procedure, specially prepared and concentrated sperm are carefully placed directly into the uterus around the time of ovulation. This process allows the sperm to reach the egg more easily, increasing the chances of successful fertilization. IUI is commonly recommended for couples facing unexplained infertility, mild male factor infertility, ovulation-related issues, or cervical problems.

owner_posts.post_text: Difficulty conceiving a year after pregnancy loss often traces back to identifiable causes, uterine fibroids, polyps, or a septum obstructing implantation; thyroid disorders affecting both fertility and miscarriage risk; or luteal phase insufficiency where progesterone levels are inadequate to sustain the uterine lining. Each of these is investigable through targeted testing. Dr. Mohit Saraogi, an IVF doctor in Ghatkopar, conducts this structured evaluation for patients who have not conceived within twelve months of loss.

Ovulatory dysfunction is among the most common causes of female infertility, when the ovaries fail to release an egg on schedule, often linked to PCOS or thyroid imbalance, there is simply no egg available for fertilisation that cycle. Blocked fallopian tubes and uterine abnormalities such as fibroids or polyps are the other leading structural causes. Dr. Mohit Saraogi, an infertility specialist in Ghatkopar, investigates each of these systematically before recommending any treatment pathway.

Couples typically undergo two to three IUI cycles before their fertility specialist reassesses the treatment plan a single attempt rarely determines whether the approach is working for a given diagnosis. Per-cycle outcomes vary depending on age, sperm parameters, and the underlying cause of infertility. Dr. Mohit Saraogi, who provides IUI Treatment in Ghatkopar, discusses realistic cycle expectations with every patient and recommends IVF when IUI cycles do not achieve the intended result.

Research across millions of IVF births consistently shows no clinically significant difference in the cognitive, physical, or psychological development of IVF-conceived children compared to those conceived naturally. From the point of uterine implantation, the developmental pathway is identical — the only difference in IVF is where fertilisation takes place. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre, an IVF specialist in Ghatkopar, addresses health outcome concerns at every consultation before any treatment decision is made.

Uterine structural issues polyps, submucosal fibroids, and intrauterine adhesions — can sit undetected on standard ultrasound and silently fail transfers with good-quality embryos until a hysteroscopy is performed. The ERA test identifies a displaced implantation window in approximately 25% of patients with repeated failure, shifting transfer timing by a full day or more. An IVF doctor in Ghatkopar, Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre conducts a full case review after every failed transfer before any next step is confirmed.

IUI bypasses the cervical stage of natural conception entirely — washed, concentrated sperm are placed directly into the uterine cavity through a thin catheter timed to coincide with confirmed ovulation. In natural conception, sperm must navigate the cervix independently, a process that filters out a significant proportion. The procedure takes under 10 minutes without anaesthesia. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre provides IUI Treatment in Ghatkopar following a full diagnostic workup before any protocol is started.

Chromosomal abnormality rates in embryos rise sharply with maternal age — at 40, more than half of embryos may be aneuploid even when morphology appears normal on visual grading. PGT-A addresses this gap by screening chromosome count before transfer, reducing the chance of selecting a non-viable embryo. As an IVF specialist in Ghatkopar, Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre applies PGT-A only when the clinical indication is clear — not as a default recommendation for all patients undergoing treatment.

AMH measures ovarian reserve but says nothing directly about egg quality or pregnancy likelihood. What it does tell a fertility specialist is how the ovaries will respond to stimulation and what dosage to begin with. Normal AMH ranges vary significantly by age: 2.5–5.0 ng/mL at 25–30, dropping to 0.5–2.5 ng/mL between 36 and 40. At the IVF Centre in Ghatkopar, Saraogi Hospital reads AMH alongside antral follicle count and full hormonal panels before any cycle is planned or recommended.

A second IVF cycle does not always mean starting over. Dr. Mohit Saraogi, an IVF specialist in Ghatkopar, explains the distinction between fresh and frozen cycles to patients clearly, helping them understand what the next stage of treatment actually involves before any decision is made.

ICSI embryo transfer success rates in India in 2026 range between 50–60% for women under 35, rising to 65–70% at centres using blastocyst culture and AI-assisted embryo grading. owner_posts.post_text: A full diagnostic workup following twelve months of failed conception after miscarriage typically begins with AMH testing, a thyroid panel, pelvic ultrasound, and semen analysis covering both partners rather than assuming the cause lies with one. Lifestyle factors including smoking, excess alcohol, chronic stress, and inadequate sleep affect fertility in both men and women, compounding the impact of any underlying medical cause already present. None of these factors alone typically explains infertility, but their combined effect is measurable. As an infertility specialist in Mumbai, Dr. Mohit Saraogi addresses modifiable lifestyle factors alongside structured diagnostic testing during every fertility consultation.

Ovulation monitoring through blood tests and ultrasound scans ensures IUI is timed accurately to the fertile window, which directly affects the likelihood of successful fertilisation in a given cycle. This monitoring is conducted throughout both natural and medicated IUI protocols. Dr. Mohit Saraogi, providing IUI Treatment in Mumbai, builds this monitoring into every treatment cycle, adjusting timing based on each patient's individual ovulatory response rather than a fixed calendar schedule.

IVF healthcare is a coordinated clinical process — ovarian stimulation, egg retrieval under ultrasound guidance, laboratory fertilisation through IVF or ICSI, embryo culture to blastocyst stage, and timed uterine transfer — supported throughout by hormonal monitoring, diagnostic review, and personalised protocol adjustments. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre, an IVF doctor in Mumbai, builds each treatment plan around individual diagnostic findings rather than a generalised fertility protocol.

Research across millions of IVF births shows no significant difference in the cognitive, physical, or psychological development of children conceived through IVF compared to those conceived naturally. Concerns about IVF babies' health persist largely because they are not consistently addressed at the consultation stage. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre, where an IVF doctor in Mumbai, integrates clear, evidence-based health outcome discussions into every patient consultation before any cycle is recommended or initiated.

AMH reflects the quantity of remaining follicles in the ovaries, but its clinical significance depends entirely on the patient's age — a reading of 1.2 ng/mL means something very different at 29 than at 41. Normal reference ranges shift with age: 2.5–5.0 ng/mL at 25–30 years, narrowing to 0.5–2.5 ng/mL between 36 and 40. As an IVF specialist in Mumbai, Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre interprets AMH alongside antral follicle count and prior stimulation response before finalising any fertility treatment approach.

IUI involves processing a semen sample in the laboratory to concentrate motile sperm, then placing them directly into the uterus via a thin catheter timed to coincide with ovulation — eliminating the cervical barrier that filtered sperm must otherwise navigate in natural conception. The procedure takes under 10 minutes and requires no anaesthesia. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre offers IUI Treatment in Mumbai with ovulation monitoring and a full diagnostic workup before any protocol is recommended.

PGT-A screens IVF embryos for chromosomal abnormalities before transfer — identifying which embryos have the correct chromosome count and reducing the risk of failed implantation and miscarriage in high-risk groups. It is most clinically relevant for women over 37, those with recurrent miscarriage, and patients with repeated implantation failure despite good-quality embryos. As an IVF specialist in Mumbai, Saraogi Hospital recommends PGT-A based on case history and failure pattern, not as a routine add-on.

No injection IVF — also referred to as natural or minimal stimulation IVF — relies on the body's own hormonal cycle to develop eggs, either without stimulation medications or with a significantly reduced oral medication protocol. It is suited to select patient profiles where conventional stimulation may not be the most appropriate path. An IVF doctor in Mumbai at Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre evaluates each patient's ovarian response and medical history before recommending this or any other fertility protocol.

AMH levels guide IVF planning but do not set a fixed cutoff for eligibility. A range of 1.0–3.5 ng/mL is considered optimal, yet cycles with AMH below 0.5 ng/mL can still proceed with adjusted stimulation protocols. Age and antral follicle count matter as much as AMH when assessing ovarian reserve. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre and IVF specialist in Mumbai, individualises stimulation plans based on the full fertility profile, not a single marker.

featured_reviews.name: Nasreen Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent Review for Dr. Pardulekar & His Clinic 🌟

Our parenthood journey was not easy — I had experienced an ectopic pregnancy, a miscarriage, and three failed IVF attempts in the USA. My family suggested Dr. Pardulekar’s name, and I am forever grateful that we decided to trust him and his clinic in Mumbai.

From the very first consultation, Dr. Pardulekar and his team showed not only medical expertise but also true humanity and compassion at every step. He personally knew my case, remembered every detail, and guided me with patience and care throughout the entire process — even after my embryo transfer when I had already returned to the USA. His constant support gave me strength and confidence during a very difficult phase of my life.

What makes this clinic stand out is that Dr. Pardulekar himself takes the time to know each patient by heart. This is rare and makes a world of difference when you are going through something as emotionally and physically demanding as IVF. Unlike other clinics I had experienced, here I truly felt cared for as a person, not just a patient.

I finally succeeded — and today I am holding my babies because of his guidance, skill, and positivity. This experience also taught me that everyone’s body is different, and success requires patience, faith, and the right doctor who stands by you.

I highly recommend Dr. Pardulekar and his clinic to anyone considering fertility treatment. Their expertise, empathy, and dedicated staff make this place exceptional. If you are on the IVF journey, having someone like Dr. Pardulekar to guide and support you is invaluable.

Forever grateful to him and his team for making our dream of parenthood come true.
